label: Non-penalty xG
description: Sum of expected-goals values of non-penalty shots.

label: Expected assists
description: Sum of xG of shots directly assisted by the player's passes.

label: Key passes
description: Passes directly leading to a shot.

label: Passes attempted
description: All open-play and set-piece passes attempted.

label: Progressive passes
description: Completed passes starting outside the defensive 40% of the pitch that end at least 25% closer to the centre of the opponent's goal.

label: Progressive carries
description: Carries starting outside the defensive 40% of the pitch that end at least 25% closer to the centre of the opponent's goal.

label: Pressures
description: Pressure actions applied to an opponent in possession.

label: Tackles won
description: Tackles that won the ball or put it out of play.

label: Ball recoveries
description: Loose balls recovered by the player.
